rows.purpose: Object: pointer to its actor transform record.
rows.evidence: Live: matched the camera target's actor.

rows.purpose: Object: 16-bit state flags; bit 0 set once activated.
rows.evidence: Live: 0x20A before activation, 0x220B after.

rows.purpose: Object: 20-bit slot index used in handles.
rows.evidence: Live: handle built from it resolved back to the same object.

rows.purpose: Object: 11-bit generation used in handles.
rows.evidence: Live: handle built from it resolved back to the same object.

rows.purpose: Object: pointer to the actor asset it was created from.
rows.evidence: Live: the hero object's field equalled the lookup of the hero actor asset; the puppet's equalled the Miles actor asset.

rows.purpose: Object: component table (descriptor, instance pairs).
rows.evidence: Live: 290 entries enumerated on the hero, 26 on the puppet.

rows.purpose: Object: 16-bit capacity of the component table.
rows.evidence: Live enumeration.

rows.purpose: Component descriptor: pointer to its class name.
rows.evidence: Live: names matched RTTI, for example SkinManager.

rows.purpose: Actor: 4x4 world matrix, translation in the last row.
rows.evidence: Live movement traces.

rows.purpose: Actor: zero while the actor is alive.
rows.evidence: Live traces and the engine's own checks.

rows.purpose: Actor: field the engine passes as the third argument of its own transform write.
rows.evidence: The hero spawn code calls the transform write with actor+0x70; the live mirror used the same call for 1772 frames.

rows.purpose: Actor: pointer to its joint matrices (4x4 floats, actor space).
rows.evidence: Live: copying the hero's array posed the puppet.

rows.purpose: Number of joints in the hero base rig.
rows.evidence: Live: 241 valid matrices, zero matrices after; scale and range measured over 1015 frames.

rows.purpose: SkinManager: pointer to its part array.
rows.evidence: Live: hero had 3 populated parts.

rows.purpose: SkinManager: number of part slots.
rows.evidence: Live: 65 on hero and puppet.

rows.purpose: SkinManager: bytes per part slot.
rows.evidence: Engine indexing constant 0x6B8; live reads lined up.

rows.purpose: Part slot: 64-bit id of its skin config.
rows.evidence: Live: ids read from the hero dressed the puppet.

rows.purpose: SkinManager vtable offset of the add-parts method.
rows.evidence: Live: call added the hero's parts to the puppet.

rows.purpose: Add-parts argument: pointer to its items.
rows.evidence: Engine accessor at 0x27DF940; live call.

rows.purpose: Add-parts argument: item count.
rows.evidence: Engine loop bound; live call.

rows.purpose: Add-parts argument: bytes per item.
rows.evidence: Engine accessor constant 0xC8; live call.

rows.purpose: Add-parts item: 64-bit skin config id.
rows.evidence: Engine read at item+0x34; live call.

rows.purpose: Look: pointer to its body-group entries (16 bytes each).
rows.evidence: norfmare's documented layout; live read gave four entries with the known mask and hood ids.

rows.purpose: Look: number of body-group entries.
rows.evidence: norfmare's documented layout; live read gave 4.

rows.purpose: MapElement component: map element type, copied from the actor's MapElement data when the component is created. The minimap picks its icon by this type. Type 1 (hero) is drawn only for the local player.
rows.evidence: Ghidra: MapElement init (0x7F2FC0) writes it from the component data; minimap draw (0x8E1C10) returns early for type 1 unless the element's object is the local hero. Live: the double's element read 1; writing other types changed its minimap icon.

rows.purpose: MapElement component: byte flag. When set, activation adds the element to the always-drawn set and the minimap shows it whatever its distance, pinned to the edge when outside the view.
rows.evidence: Ghidra: MapElement activate (0x7F32F0) adds the element to the set at exe+0x670C8B8 when this flag is set; the minimap update (0x8E3890) draws every element in that set. Live: with the flag set the double's marker showed at 8 m and at 85 m.

rows.purpose: Lighting system: current lighting mode index (int32, 0-6).
rows.evidence: GetLightingModeAction's execute (0xDC3950) reads it to pick the mode's hash. Live: read 2, then 4 a second after requesting 4.

rows.purpose: Lighting system: the object set_lighting_mode is called on.
rows.evidence: SetLightingModeAction's execute passes lighting system + 0xE10D0. Live call worked.

rows.purpose: Size of one object slot in object_table.
rows.evidence: resolve_handle multiplies the index by 0xC0.

rows.purpose: Actor asset: its 64-bit asset id.
rows.evidence: Live: actor_asset_lookup of the u64 at asset+8 returned the same asset for the firefighter and melee thug actors.

rows.purpose: AnimControllerComponent: first of its rig slots, each a pointer to a rig description.
rows.evidence: Live: hero slots 0-7 point at rigs reading 241; firefighters 135; civilians 124-159; matches the joint matrices actually animated. A freshly spawned (inert) bot has none.

rows.purpose: AnimControllerComponent: bytes between rig slots.
rows.evidence: Live: hero slots at +0x130, +0x160, +0x190 and on.

rows.purpose: Rig description: number of joints (u16).
rows.evidence: Live: 241 for the hero's rig, 135 for the firefighter's.

rows.purpose: Config asset entry: pointer to the loaded config object.
rows.evidence: Live: the system menu entry's +0x30 had RTTI UISystemMenuConfig.

rows.purpose: UISystemMenuConfig: MainMenu (the pause list) item array pointer.
rows.evidence: Live: first item's label PAUSE_OPTION_RESUME; MainMenu label Main Menu at +0x140.

rows.purpose: UISystemMenuConfig: number of pause list items (u32).
rows.evidence: Live: 12; raising it showed added items in the pause list.

rows.purpose: UISystemMenuConfig: room in the pause list item array (u32).
rows.evidence: Live: 16.

rows.purpose: Size of one pause list item.
rows.evidence: Live: labels 0xA8 apart.

rows.purpose: Menu item: id (u32) as menu_select receives it.
rows.evidence: Live: 0, 1, 0x3C, 8, 2, 0x60, 0x1F, 3, 4, 5, 7, 6 for the twelve items in config order.

rows.purpose: Menu item: label tag (char*).
rows.evidence: Live.

rows.purpose: Menu item: label tag length (u32).
rows.evidence: Live: 0x13 for PAUSE_OPTION_RESUME.

rows.purpose: Menu item: string_hash of the label tag (u32), which the text lookup uses.
rows.evidence: Live: 0x72BB280D for PAUSE_OPTION_RESUME.

rows.purpose: random_crime_system: seconds until it next picks a crime (float, counts down).
rows.evidence: Live: 58.3 then 56.3 two seconds later; set to 0.5, it picked a crime (a crime marker appeared) and reset to 75.

rows.purpose: Warp action given to warp_object: pointer to an object (whose handle it sends).
rows.evidence: Decompiled 0x1B81410: reads *(action+8) as an object.

rows.purpose: Warp action given to warp_object: byte flag; set, the hero leaves a perch or ledge and stays at the warp target.
rows.evidence: Live: from a lamp-post perch, a warp with this byte set left the hero at the target (he dropped to the street); with it clear he slid back to the perch. +0x60 = 1 and +0x65 = 1 did not do this.
